title: E-mail address
description: E-mail address of a supervisor: an ASCII local part of letters, digits and _ % + ' - in dot-separated parts, and a domain name of at least two labels (letters, digits, hyphen; an internationalized domain in its xn-- form). No quoted local part, no domain literal (a@[127.0.0.1]), no non-ASCII. The pattern makes the decision independent of the validator: format email alone is implementation-defined, and opis accepts domain literals that Ajv refuses (docs/decisions.md).
